caseName: Hubbard v. Campbell, Commissioner, Alabama Department of Corrections
caseNameFull: Hubbard v. Campbell, Commissioner, Alabama Department of Corrections

opinions.text:
C. A. 11th Cir. Application for stay of execution of sentence of death, pre *959 sented to Justice Kennedy, and by him referred to the Court, denied. Certiorari denied.

Justice Stevens, Justice Souter, Justice Ginsburg, and Justice Breyer would grant the application for stay of execution.
